---
Test
---
!define TEST_SYSTEM {slim}
!3 Failing comparisons for JSON Lines, text and CSV: what the cells show
This page fails on purpose (it is not part of any suite): it shows how differences are rendered when a '''check … OK''' row fails.

|import|
|io.github.tortaje.compare|

|script|json lines comparison|
|key|ref|
|check|compare file|src/test/resources/e2e/expected/orders.jsonl|to|{{{
{"id":"o-1","ref":"A-1","createdAt":"2026-10-30T14:05:00Z","total":10}
{"id":"o-2","ref":"A-2","createdAt":"yesterday","total":25}
{"id":"o-4","ref":"A-4","createdAt":"2026-10-30T14:08:00Z","total":1}
}}}|OK|

|script|text comparison|
|check|compare file|src/test/resources/e2e/expected/app.log|to|{{{08:00 INFO Application started
08:01 ERROR Order A-7 rejected
08:02 WARN Slow query: fast ms
}}}|OK|

|script|csv comparison|
|separator|;|
|key|id|
|check|compare file|src/test/resources/e2e/expected/export.csv|to|{{{
id;label;amount
1;Widget;12
3;Gizmo;5.5
4;Doohickey;1
}}}|OK|
